messages.author: e27f916765f79080
messages.subject: ggvis in markdown documents
parts:
Hi all,

I made a short comparison of different interactive visualization packages in R, including ggvis. See the post here:
http://ouzor.github.io/blog/2014/11/21/interactive-visualizations.html

The line chart plot with ggvis does not show up in the html version for some reason. Can somebody help me with that?

And since I'm using a jekyll-powered blog, I had to somehow make sure that the javascript libraries needed by ggvis were included in the final document. I guess there could be a better solution than what I did, see the Issues-section in the post for more details.

- Juuso
